scenes.line1: How do you know your app is ready?
scenes.say: How do you know your app is actually ready for launch? Is seeing the homepage load really enough?

scenes.label: Smoke
scenes.sub: Quick hits: does the app respond at all?
scenes.say: Start with a smoke test. Just check if the app responds at all, not if every feature works.

scenes.title: Simulate real users
lines: # or use JMeter or Azure Load Testing
scenes.say: Next, run a load test. Simulate hundreds of users at once to see if things slow down or break.
Test resilience. Stop one backend and watch if the load balancer drains it smoothly, with no errors for users.

scenes.label: UAT
scenes.sub: Business users run their test cases
scenes.say: Finally, business users do user acceptance testing. They run their cases and sign off in writing.

scenes.question: Which test do teams often skip?
scenes.right: Failover—pulling a node to check resilience
scenes.say: Here's a trap: most teams skip the failover test. Pulling a node in a test environment is cheap. Missing a health check in production is not.
